purpose: Teach: ヨット/カビ/就寝/ポッドキャスト/セルフ/時差/三位一体/皇太子

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヨットの絵本を読んで下さるって
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to read you that sailboat picture book.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Slight uplift at the end like sharing good news. Soft presence—not performing, just letting him know what's coming.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お風呂のカビ取りお父さんと手伝ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I helped Dad clean the mold in the bathtub.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Not loud—just matter-of-fact sharing of something he and Dad did together. Small smile in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、就寝前に歯磨きを忘れずにね
lines.en: Sho, make sure you brush your teeth before bed, okay?
lines.style: Practical reminder, warm but efficient. Said while doing something else—not turning to face him directly. Habitual kindness in the cadence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとポッドキャストを聴いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I listened to a podcast together.
lines.style: Soft excitement. He's not trying to impress—just wants her to know what happened. Slight pause after 'together' like the togetherness is the whole point.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがセルフのご飯の盛り方を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught you how to serve yourself rice properly.
lines.style: Noticing tone—she's observed this happened and is reflecting on it. Warm appreciation for what Ryosuke is doing. Slightly slower pace, like turning something over in her mind.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと時差の話したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I talked about time zones.
lines.style: Simple delivery, genuine. He's reporting facts but with a sense of quiet wonder underneath. The kind of conversation a six-year-old remembers because it mattered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが三位一体の絵本をお持ちよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has that picture book about the Trinity.
lines.style: Observing, slightly amused. She's noticed Ryosuke collecting these particular books. Gentle amusement at the pattern. Warmth toward both of them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、皇太子殿下の絵を描いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I drew a picture of the Crown Prince.
lines.style: Direct, innocent statement. A small voice proud of what he made. No expectation—just sharing. The 'close' suggests intimacy, vulnerability in showing her.
